title: Pencil sharpener
prompt: a desk-clamp crank pencil sharpener: insert a pencil, turn the crank, shavings fall into the drawer, pull out a sharp pencil; see-through shows the planetary helical cutters, gear train and clamp
blurb: Turn the crank and two helical cutters orbit the pencil, spinning on a fixed ring gear as they shave a cone point and drop the curls into the drawer.
